These are the top 5 Hacker News front-page stories, taken from an accessibility snapshot of the page:

| # | Title | Points |
|---|-------|--------|
| 1 | The recently proposed o(n log n) integer multiplication algorithm [pdf] (unsw.edu.au) | 120 |
| 2 | WorldTUI: I trained a 360M model to pretend to be a terminal (simedw.com) | 58 |
| 3 | There isn't an easy exploit for this PHP vulnerability (eliastaylor.com) | 387 |
| 4 | Security Disclosure (railway.com) | 401 |
| 5 | GitLab critical patch release (docs.gitlab.com) | 300 |

I used only the browser tools and ran no JavaScript. Before the snapshot reached me, a layer called "tokensave-mcp-diet" shortened it from about 27k to 12.8k characters by removing link targets and layout noise. All the story titles and point counts were still in it.
